title: Taking a Spending Restriction off an Employee Meal Account
content:
A spending restriction on an Employee Meal Account is taken off by returning the account to the active state, and what the account still owes is restated in the same movement.

The charges an account carries forward at reinstatement are fixed only after the charges awaiting recovery stand net of the recovery entry due for the payroll period the account's latest accrued charge belongs to. Until the charges awaiting recovery stand net of that period's recovery entry, the figure carried forward is not fixed.

The charges carried forward are worked out only once the stored value standing on the account has been raised by the paydown the plan calls for.

## What the restatement governs

What is governed here is the figure for charges awaiting payroll recovery the account carries forward once the restriction is off. Payroll tender works again at the till from that moment, and the employee sees the restated figure on the account.

## Booking it

The desk unlocks the agent tool `lift_meal_account_restriction_a306574a` and calls it. The call moves the account back into the active state, clears the day the restriction began, sets the charges awaiting payroll recovery to the figure stated, and books a settlement entry on the account's transaction ledger for the movement that restatement makes.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `meal_account_id` | The reference number of the Employee Meal Account whose restriction is being taken off | An account reference, read from the meal account lookup before the call |
| `arrears_carried_usd` | The charges awaiting payroll recovery the account carries forward once the restriction is off, in USD | Recorded to 2 decimal places and rounded half to even at that precision; stored as a positive magnitude; an empty value is not accepted |

### What comes back

A plain confirmation sentence naming the meal account reference, the state the account now stands in, the charges awaiting payroll recovery carried forward in USD to two decimal places, and the reference of the settlement entry booked for the movement. The named active state is what indicates the restriction has been taken off.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose action is this?** The desk's own; the tool is an agent tool, unlocked and called by the agent handling the account.

**What does the account show afterwards?** It stands active, with no day of restriction recorded against it, and the charges awaiting payroll recovery stand at the restated figure.
